# agate

> agate turns compute into a financial asset: an open onchain price for GPU-hours that anyone, whether a person, an app or an agent, can trade, hedge or build on. Monad testnet, test dollars.

- Index: a daily GPU-hour rental price per GPU (median of several clouds), written onchain by Chainlink CRE.
- Market: monthly tokens per GPU that pay the month's average index price; Long gains when GPU rent rises, Short when it falls; optional daily payouts ("pay me daily").
- Agents: a hosted MCP server (OAuth 2.1 or a private connector URL). Each AI connection trades from its own pocket within limits the person sets; the limits are enforced by agate's server and an onchain session key (Dynamic Transaction Review is built and waits on Dynamic for Monad testnet).

## Docs

- [Documentation](docs/site/README.md): every chapter, from the quickstart to the contracts; one markdown file each.
- [Claims a judge can check](docs/judge.md): each claim with the file and line that enforces it.
- [For AI agents](agents/AGENTS.md): connect, tools, limits, rules.
- [Claude Code plugin](agents/claude-plugin): MCP over OAuth plus the agate skill.
- [Server API](server/API.md): the app-facing API (Connect your AI, approvals, activity).
- [How the price is made](docs/site/04-the-price.md): sources, daily formula, countersign, carried days, 48 h notice.
- [Onchain feeds](docs/site/09-onchain.md): the index contract and a Chainlink-style feed per GPU on Monad testnet.
- [Developer API](docs/site/08-api.md): public read-only market data under /v1 (prices with sources, history, months, books, trades, candles), no key.
- [Wallets](wallet/README.md): main account, Assistant, pocket; measured timings on Monad testnet.
